# CiOL

> > CiOL covers enterprise technology, AI developments, cybersecurity, and digital transformation with a focus on India's tech ecosystem and global innovation.

CiOL (Cyber India Online) provides news, interviews, and analysis on artificial intelligence, enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology leadership. The publication tracks major players like OpenAI, Google, IBM, and Anthropic while highlighting India's role in global tech adoption and AI talent development.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise AI
- AI Agents and Agentic AI
- OpenAI and ChatGPT
- Google Cloud and Gmail
- Anthropic Claude
- India Tech Ecosystem
- Cybersecurity and Identity Security
- Executive Appointments
- AI-Powered Learning and Upskilling
- Business Expansion
- IBM Infrastructure
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
- Workflow Automation
- AI Governance and Trust
- Pentagon AI Partnerships

- [Ramco's Launches Chia Targets 60% Ticket Deflection in Enterprise AI Push](https://www.ciol.com/news/ramco-systems-launches-chia-enterprise-agentic-ai-platform-11102754): Ramco launches Chia no-code AI platform targeting 60% ticket deflection
- [IBM Opens Infrastructure Innovation Center In India For Enterprise AI](https://www.ciol.com/enterprise/ibm-opens-infrastructure-innovation-center-in-india-for-enterprise-ai-11177708): IBM launches Sangam Infrastructure Innovation Center in Bengaluru for AI
- [Perplexity's Model Council Aims to Fix the Model Choice Problem](https://www.ciol.com/tech-buzz/perplexitys-model-council-aims-to-fix-the-model-choice-problem-11097287): Perplexity launches Model Council to compare multiple AI models simultaneously
